title: Merchant Operation Project Manager
description:
About Us:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more:Keeta website

What You'll Do:

  • Deliver Outcomes: Ensure all projects align with business objectives, drive implementation, and enhance business growth and efficiency. Monitor key project execution, identify risks, and drive resolutions to achieve business targets.Utilize data analysis and performance management to quantify project impact and optimize resource allocation.
  • Project Management: Develop and optimize project management frameworks, standards, and processes to ensure smooth project execution. Organize and lead project meetings, track progress, and drive cross-department collaboration. Monitor project timelines, costs, quality, and risks to ensure efficient delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Communication & Collaboration: Act as the key coordinator for project management, ensuring communication among business, technology, finance, and other teams. Resolve cross-functional challenges during project execution to enhance overall operational efficiency. Organize cross-team training sessions to improve project management capabilities.

What We Need From You:

  • Experience in PMO or project management.
  • Result-Oriented: Strong business-driving capabilities, ensuring projects are guided by final business outcomes.
  • Experience with OKR or KPI goal management. Familiar with common project managment tools and methodologies.
  • Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
  • Proficient in both Chinese and English as working languages. Portuguese speakers will be given priority.

What Make This Role Exciting:

  • Early-stage business: Opportunity to participate in the initial planning, design, and implementation of key projects.
  • International team: Work with members from 26 countries and experience a diverse work environment.

title: Senior Social Media & Influencer Specialist
description:
Job Summary:

1、Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement in the Brazilian market.

2、Manage and collaborate with a network of influencers, ensuring alignment with brand values and objectives, and fostering long-term partnerships.

3、Track, analyze, and report on social media performance metrics to optimize content and campaigns, and provide insights for decision-making.

4、Create and curate compelling content for various social media platforms, staying up-to-date with trends and best practices.

5、Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, PR, and creative departments, to ensure cohesive messaging and campaign integration.

6、Hiring influencers and embassadors to AliExperts program.

7、PM Development of AliExperts project growing the influencer base as well as impacted consumers.

Qualifications:

1、Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

2、Above 5 years of experience in social media management, with a proven track record in the Brazilian market.

3、Deep understanding of major social media platforms, algorithms, and best practices for content creation and distribution.

4、Strong networking skills and experience in managing influencer relationships, negotiating contracts, and measuring ROI.

5、Fluent in Portuguese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

6、Proven ability to lead and manage projects, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

7、Experience working in a global company or with cross-cultural teams is preferred.

8、Experience working in an ecommerce company is preferred.

9、Previous experience in developing brand campaigns will be a bonus

10、Fluent in English and English resume only!!!!

title: Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / remote, in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Data Analytics and AI is responsible for defining and guiding the architecture of Brasil and Canada's data and artificial intelligence ecosystems, enabling the extraction of strategic insights from large volumes of operational and corporate data. He will work strategically in the design and governance of advanced analytics, machine learning, deep learning, predictive models, cognitive automation, and scalable data platforms.

This professional will work closely with data engineering, data science, operations, IT, and business teams, ensuring that data platforms are architected to support efficiency, security, scalability, regulatory compliance, and continuous innovation in mining and energy.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve data and AI architectures, including data lake design, data warehouses, machine learning platforms, data pipelines, orchestration, and governance.
  • Design solutions for data ingestion, storage, processing, analysis and visualization in highly complex environments, integrating multiple data sources (IoT, industrial sensing, ERP, cloud).
  • Lead initiatives to implement advanced analytical models, cognitive automation, explainable artificial intelligence, and machine/deep learning platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and data security, including in the cloud, by applying best governance practices.
  • Work together with multidisciplinary teams on digital transformation projects, providing architectural and technical expertise for strategic use of data.
  • Produce detailed documentation, architectural plans, policies, and technical standards that promote scalability, reuse, and efficient governance.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and technologies to enhance analytics ecosystems, including AI frameworks, AI Ops, cloud platforms, and big data.
  • Foster data culture, technical capacity building and best practices through training, workshops and mentoring.
  • Participate in technical forums and communities to keep the architecture aligned with global trends and business needs.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of solid experience in data architecture, analytics and artificial intelligence in multinational companies or industrial/mining sector.
  • Expertise em frameworks e ferramentas de dados e IA: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP AI Platform.
  • Deep knowledge in design and administration of data lakes, data warehouses, streams, NoSQL databases, Lambda/Kappa architectures.
  • Experience in creating and managing data pipelines, data governance, data quality, automation and CI/CD for AI models.
  • Solid knowledge in data security, privacy, regulatory compliance (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Fluent English for technical and strategic communication; advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Strategic technical leadership skills, fluency in communication with different audiences.
  • Analytical and strategic vision to connect data to business decisions and innovation.
  • Proactivity, adaptability, and collaboration in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Results-oriented approach and continuous improvement.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações avançadas: Cloudera/Databricks Certified, Azure Data Scientist, AWS Big Data Specialty, Google Professional Data Engineer, TOGAF.
  • Experience in digital mining projects, industrial IoT, digital twins, predictive analytics and AI Ops.
  • Participation in global technical programs and communities, international publications or presentations.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture of data and AI ecosystems for Brazil and Canada, supporting predictive analytics, operational intelligence and innovation.
  • Execution of strategic digital transformation projects driven by data, machine learning and AI.
  • Dissemination of data governance, policies, training and technical enablement.
  • Audit, compliance, and data security support.
  • Direct influence on data-driven decision-making, sustainability and global operational excellence.

Additional Comments:

This professional will play a key role in data-driven transformation, enabling operational excellence and innovation in Brazil and Canada, working in a dynamic, integrated environment of high technological and regulatory complexity.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Enterprise Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Job Description:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position Vale as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects,
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.

Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Analista de Abastecimento e Compras de Alimentos e Bebidas SR | TFC | São Paulo
description:
Sobre a Empresa

No TFC Food&Market somos responsáveis por aprimorar a experiência dos clientes conectando-os a um estilo ativo e saudável através do universo de alimentos e bebidas e proporcionando um espaço integrado nas lojas com opções para uma alimentação mais saudável e equilibrada, e com produtos selecionados pela nossa curadoria no mini market.

Sobre o Cargo

A TFC Food&Market busca de um profissional qualificado para ocupar a posição de Analista Sênior de Abastecimento e Compras de Alimentos e Bebidas para compor o time. Esse analista responsável pelo abastecimento de alimentos, bebidas e embalagens das lojas visando sempre uma gestão inteligente de estoque e fluxos, considerando perecibilidade e sazonalidade dos itens juntamente com a demanda individual do time e a necessidade de cada loja.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento e Controle de Abastecimento;
  • Planejar o fluxo de reposição de Alimentos e Bebidas para todas as lojas, considerando giro, cobertura e prazos de entrega;
  • Assegurar níveis adequados de estoque, prevenindo rupturas e excessos;
  • Controlar pedidos internos, validando quantidades, prazos e acompanhando pendências com logística e fornecedores;
  • Definir estoques mínimos e máximos conforme demanda, sazonalidade e shelf life dos produtos;
  • Atuar como elo entre lojas, centro de distribuição e fornecedores, garantindo disponibilidade e regularidade no abastecimento;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de loja nas previsões de consumo e no planejamento de reposição;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de abastecimento e transferência entre unidades;
  • Executar o abastecimento interestadual e intrapolítico (dentro de São Paulo), conforme calendário e prioridade operacional;
  • Monitorar indicadores de ruptura, cobertura e giro por meio de dashboards de performance;
  • Garantir o cumprimento do Enxoval Padrão em toda a rede.

Qualificações

  • Graduação necessária: Concluída ou Cursando em Logística, Gastronomia, Nutrição, Administração.

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Domínio de conceitos de estoque: cobertura, giro, curva ABC, ponto de reposição e shelf life.
  • Capacidade de planejar e ajustar o fluxo de abastecimento conforme histórico de vendas, demanda e sazonalidade.
  • Conhecimento em processos de transferência e reposição entre lojas e centros de distribuição.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado e experiência com ERP de gestão de estoque e compras. Usamos Ciss.
  • Entendimento de fluxos logísticos, lead time e priorização de entregas, principalmente.
  • Perfil organizado, analítico e proativo, com boa comunicação e foco em resultados operacionais.
  • Autonomia para execução, garantindo alinhamento com as políticas e prazos da área.

Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Organização e disciplina: gerencia múltiplas tarefas e prazos simultâneos.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa: identifica problemas e propõe soluções operacionais.
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa: articula informações entre lojas, estoque e fornecedores.
  • Foco em resultados: mantém disponibilidade de produtos e eficiência do estoque.
  • Atenção a detalhes: evita rupturas, excessos e perdas.
  • Autonomia: toma decisões operacionais dentro das políticas da área.

title: Secretária
description:
SECRETÁRIA CRC | CLÍNICA ODONTOLÓGICA SORRISOS

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS: EXPERIÊNCIA EM CLÍNICA MÉDICA OU ODONTOLÓGICA + RESIDIR NOS BAIRROS ESPECÍFICOS MENCIONADOS ABAIXO

QUEM SOMOS:

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.

NOSSA VISÃO

Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:

• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas • Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança • Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade

POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?

• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

• Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)

. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto "Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.

IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.

Se você acredita no poder de um sorriso para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com propósito, queremos conhecer você!

title: Director, Business Value Consulting
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Remote: Sao Paulo, Brazil
Your Career
In this Director Business Value Consulting role, you will build value-based business-cases for cybersecurity investment, by leading cross-functional teams composed of customer-executives, sales team, solution consultants, and other functional groups. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
Your Impact
  • Support the sales process by providing expertise in value-based selling
  • Contribute to team thought leadership by synthesizing experiences into reusable content and frameworks
  • Develop and deliver value-focused training and workshops for customers
  • Elevate the value function internally, influencing field sales strategies for key accounts
  • Lead cross-functional, multi-department engagement teams with our partners, customers, and senior Palo Alto Networks experts from sales, pre-sales, consulting, and solution architecture—working to shape and drive cybersecurity and digital transformation capabilities
  • Coach team members by leveraging consulting expertise to identify C-level strategic issues, assess process capabilities, and develop business cases for IT and security transformation
  • Create industry-specific and Palo Alto Networks solution-based value selling tools, programs, and initiatives for sales, alliances, and marketing teams
  • Support value-selling training initiatives across the sales ecosystem
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 12+ years of experience, preferably with a top management consulting firm or technology company, focusing on business transformation
  • Expertise in building business cases with in-depth financial analysis and ROI/TCO modeling
  • Strong executive presence and situational awareness, with a proven track record of influencing C-suite leaders to drive key business decisions
  • Proven ability to foster accountability and build consensus across teams and customers, driving operational excellence and ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, applying consulting frameworks and methodologies, while offering creative solutions to drive executive decisions
  • Ability to quickly adapt and contribute to projects across various industries, including IT and OT challenges in cybersecurity, business applications, and systems
  • Experience in Cyber Risk Assessment, Cybersecurity, and Cloud Sales & Strategy are highly desirable
  • MBA preferred
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English.
  • Palo Alto Networks Cybersecurity Apprentice and Cybersecurity Practitioner certifications are strongly encouraged
Additional Information
The Team
Business Value Consulting is a strategic, consultative team that engages with Fortune 1000 and public sector customers to build and deliver strategic business justification as their cybersecurity partner. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)

$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses

We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.

Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.

What You'll Actually Do

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.

Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data

Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.

Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.

High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.

Application Process:

Step 1: Submit Application

  • Current CV/resume
  • Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)
  • Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked

Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.

Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.

Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.

Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.

Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: Especialista de Inovação para Inteligência Artificial (PO de IA)
description:
A Unimed-BH

Cuidar de vidas é o nosso propósito.

Buscamos oferecer a melhor experiência por meio da inovação contínua dos nossos produtos e serviços. Temos o compromisso com a sociedade e atuamos de maneira comprometida com a sustentabilidade.

Somos comprometidos em encontrar soluções ágeis e simples em nosso dia a dia para realizar as melhores entregas para a cooperativa.

Esse é o nosso jeito de trabalhar. Esperamos você para fazer parte do nosso time.

É necessário que tenha:

  • Formação superior completa;

  • Conhecimento de IA e ciência de dados suficiente para dialogar com times técnicos sobre modelos, métricas e viabilidade e Conhecimento aplicado de MLOps no que tange a ciclo de vida completo de modelos (desenvolvimento, implantação, monitoramento e evolução).
  • Familiaridade em arquiteturas de IA Generativa e vivência prática com LLMs (Large Language Models) e agentes autônomos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos técnicos em valor de negócio;
  • Modelagem de monetização em IA: estratégias de pricing (subscription, pay-per-use, revenue share) e growth engines (acquisition + retention / land and expand).

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar como PO do portfólio de IA, acompanhando todos os modelos em desenvolvimento, mesmo aqueles que não estejam sob sua execução direta.
  • Gerir prazos, resultados e entregas, cobrando accountability das áreas envolvidas e garantindo alinhamento estratégico.
  • Conduzir execuções via inovação aberta, coordenando parceiros especialistas (outsourcing) para acelerar POCs, pilotos e escalabilidade de modelos.
  • Interagir de forma qualificada com cientistas de dados, engenheiros e profissionais técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em prioridades de desenvolvimento.
  • Elaborar e defender apresentações executivas para diretoria, conselho e demais stakeholders.
  • Engajar e mobilizar líderes das áreas de negócio, assegurando que estes se tornem patrocinadores e usuários ativos das soluções de IA.
  • Exercer autoridade técnica e institucional, sendo reconhecido como referência em IA, com postura agregadora e inspiradora.
  • Construir pontes internas: envolver áreas críticas e potenciais dificultadores da inovação, desenvolvendo estratégias de colaboração que aumentem fluidez e escalabilidade das iniciativas.
  • Atuar como porta-voz de inovações: representar e defender os projetos de IA em fóruns executivos, com clareza e posicionamento para quebrar paradigmas e destravar decisões.
  • Fortalecer conexões no ecossistema interno: aproximar-se dos demais POs de TI de áreas de negócio, ampliando a integração;
  • Monitorar e aplicar tendências, boas práticas e estimulando benchmarks de IA contribuindo para a evolução e atualização constante das iniciativas da empresa;

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • 44h semanais - regime híbrido;

title: Product Manager
description:

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases: concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega de valor para os cooperados por meio da estruturação de histórias de usuário e épicos bem definidos.

Responsável em conduzir o Discovery de produto, analisando a causa raiz das dores dos usuários, levantando hipóteses e validando ideias para garantir que as soluções sejam aderentes às necessidades dos cooperados, direcionando o desenvolvimento do produto para o resultado desejado e ajudando a remover os obstáculos que possam impedir a entrega esperada.

Liderar times ágeis, garantindo entregas eficientes e alinhadas às expectativas dos cooperados.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro, regulatórias e tecnológicas para manter os produtos competitivos.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto/projetos: Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Elaboração e gestão de backlog: saber escrever histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite, priorizar com base em valor de negócio.

Conhecimento em tecnologia: Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto: Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

Conhecimento em produtos financeiros: especialmente relacionados gestão dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamentos (TED/DOC, boletos, carteiras digitais, adquirência, recorrência, split de pagamentos, convênios).

Experiência com frameworks de priorização: Conhecimento em frameworks como RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs. Effort, Kano, entre outros, para auxiliar na priorização de iniciativas.

Conhecimento em Product Discovery: Domínio das etapas de discovery contínuo, entrevistas com usuários, mapeamento de jornada, análise de concorrência e prototipação rápida.

Experiência como Product Manager ou posição similar em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos como fintechs, bancos ou cooperativas.

Formação em áreas como Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou afins.

- Tera, PM3.

- ICP-APO (ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Product Ownership)

Conhecimento sobre regulamentação do Banco Central.

Vivência em construção de jornadas omnichannel (integração digital + físico).

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions, supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talent to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Operations & 3PL Governance

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control, establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).
  • Conduct advanced, systematic auditing of 3PL adherence to SOPs and safety protocols, initiating corrective actions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide expert advisory and practical support for NF-e invoicing, freight reconciliation, and assistance with complex ICMS tax reporting processes.

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Inspetor de qualidade
description:
Resumo do Cargo:

Responsável por realizar inspeções e testes nos equipamentos e componentes da linha de concreto (bombas estacionárias, caminhões-betoneira, usinas, entre outros), assegurando que todos os produtos estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, especificações técnicas e normas internas da Zoomlion Brasil. Atua de forma preventiva e corretiva, garantindo a confiabilidade do processo produtivo e a satisfação do cliente final.

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar inspeções dimensionais, visuais e funcionais em peças, subconjuntos e produtos acabados da linha de concreto;
  • Verificar a conformidade dos itens com base em desenhos técnicos, instruções de trabalho e planos de inspeção;
  • Efetuar registros de inspeção e preencher relatórios de não conformidade (RNC), quando necessário;
  • Acompanhar testes de desempenho e funcionamento dos equipamentos antes da liberação final;
  • Identificar e sinalizar produtos não conformes, garantindo o correto tratamento e rastreabilidade;
  • Apoiar na análise de causas de não conformidades e na implementação de ações corretivas;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos de qualidade e segurança durante todo o processo produtivo;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Produção e Pós-Venda para melhorias contínuas de processo e produto;
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas de qualidade, quando solicitado.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico em Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Qualidade ou áreas correlatas);
  • Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico e instrumentos de medição (paquímetro, micrômetro, súbito, entre outros);
  • Experiência anterior na área de inspeção de qualidade industrial, preferencialmente no setor de máquinas pesadas, equipamentos de construção ou linha de concreto;
  • Conhecimento básico em processos de solda, pintura e montagem mecânica;
  • Noções de normas ISO 9001 e ferramentas da qualidade (5S, PDCA, Ishikawa, etc.);
  • Desejável conhecimento em Excel e sistemas ERP.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

"TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you'll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You'll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you'll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package (€61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your "home office" into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.

Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).

Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.

Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.

Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.

Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.

Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.

Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.

CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

title: Engineering Manager - Commercial Integration (Brazil)
description:
*Please note this position will be located in Brazil; Candidates must be located in this region OR willing to relocate. Please submit application in English.*

This role is responsible for the design, advancement, and implementation of commercial integration initiatives for automated bio-devices for the global poultry, livestock, and aquaculture industries. The role will work closely with a cross functional team comprised of design, automation, controls, quality, program managers, supply chain, IT, and production to transition new products from prototype to production, installation, and sustained in-the-field operations. This vacancy is to be filled with a highly creative, seasoned, hands-on manager, who will lead design teams to deliver engineered-to-order automated vaccination and poultry sex identification systems in Central and South America. Responsibilities range from initial characterization of customer operations, through the design of the installation and workflow, negotiation of customer acceptance of the design, and execution of site acceptance testing. This position currently reports to Sr. Director of Operations.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide strong technical knowledge and leadership to mechanical and electrical designers to deliver engineered-to-order system-level automation solutions.
  • Interact with sales/marketing and customers to identify requirements to integrate automated vaccination and poultry sex identification systems into existing automation systems.
  • Deliver system level installation design packages that will include 2D & 3D layout drawings, electrical one-line schematics, and other documents accurately and on-time.
  • Provide on-site, hands-on leadership for installation events and pre-installation assessment visits at customer facilities (poultry hatcheries). Includes Weekends.
  • Provide project management for custom engineering and installation projects including managing schedule, budget, TARGAN engineering/manufacturing efforts, customer coordination, and third-party contractor coordination.
  • Work interactively with R&D Controls Engineering to deliver system level automation customizations.
  • Work interactively with Field Installation and Support staff to deliver timely resolution of field technical issues.
  • Mentor early experience colleagues to raise the skills of the commercial integration team within the systems engineering organization.
  • Communicate effectively across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Lead a team of manufacturing, process, component, and test engineers to integrate new products and support existing products in manufacturing.
  • Ensure the current as-built design, bill-of-materials, and the change history, for every deployed product, system, and sub-systems is fully documented and made available to the engineering and operations teams for reference.
  • Advocate for sustainable design principles, materials, and methodologies in product development.
  • Stay updated with the latest sustainability trends, regulations, and technologies in the industrial automation space.
  • Characterize operations at customer site (initially in chicken hatcheries) including available space, existing workflow, existing equipment, installation ingress/egress, utility availability (electric, compressed air, water, drainage).
  • Develop layouts for integration of TARGAN equipment into customer operations including physical layout, integration with existing equipment, utilities, and workflow.
  • Collaborate with customers and field service representatives to refine layouts and find creative solutions to difficult installation conditions.
  • Together with a team of mechanical designers, develop complete designs with schematics and assembly drawings.
  • Collaborate with the manufacturing organization to ensure correct assembly of required components and execution of factory acceptance tests.
  • Provide technical guidance and resolve problems during the installation process and oversee site acceptance tests.
  • Collaborate with field service representatives to ensure smooth commissioning of the new equipment.

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Must be fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English
  • Demonstrated experience delivering system level industrial automation solutions involving motion control, vision-based sensors, industrial PLCs, industrial PCs, and/or industrial network architectures.
  • Demonstrated customer-facing skills related to gathering customer requirements and delivering world class technical support.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven record of team development and mentorship.
  • Familiarity with industry standards, certifications, and best practices related to sustainability in industrial automation.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Prior experience in the industrial automation equipment industry.
  • Familiarity with regulatory standards and compliances.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Ability to multitask and perform well under pressure and deadlines.
  • Proficient in designing systems in SolidWorks (required) and electrical systems in AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical (preferred)
  • Familiarity with machine safety standards such as ISO 13849 and UL508a
  • Familiarity with CE and UL certification
  • Experience designing sheet metal components and welded assemblies
  • Experience developing motion-based electro-mechanical sub-systems

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years' experience in mechanical engineering or related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience integrating motion-based electro-mechanical and/or automation equipment
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience leading technical teams of 2-4 people

title: Back End Developer
description:
At SOTEC Consulting-Astek Group are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust backend services and real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Spring Boot microservices, and Apache Flink. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and stream processing, with a passion for building scalable and high-performance backend solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Spring Boot microservices, with a strong emphasis on event-driven architectures powered by Apache Kafka.
  • Implement and optimize Kafka producers, consumers, and stream processing applications, leveraging Apache Flink for real-time data streaming and analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, DevOps, and fellow developers to ensure seamless integration of Kafka, Flink, and microservices across the backend ecosystem.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Kafka clusters and Flink jobs to guarantee performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Ensure data security, compliance, and adherence to best practices in all Kafka and Flink-related implementations.
  • Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and agile ceremonies, contributing to continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Document architectures, technical solutions, and maintain comprehensive and up-to-date system documentation.

Must Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in backend development, with a strong focus on Apache Kafka and Spring Boot microservices.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Apache Flink for real-time data processing and streaming.
  • Proficiency in Java or Scala for backend and stream-processing applications.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices design patterns.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, message brokers, and data serialization formats (e.g., Avro, JSON).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
  • Good communication skills in Portguese (B2 minimum) and English (B1)

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS).
  • Knowledge of additional streaming frameworks or technologies.
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools, such as the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).

This is a hybrid position and the candidate selected will need to be present in the office some days.

title: Técnico em segurança

A pessoa Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho será responsável por promover, orientar e assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança e saúde no ambiente laboral. Atuará de forma preventiva para identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável. Para ter sucesso no cargo, é fundamental manter atenção aos detalhes, comunicar-se de forma clara e eficaz, e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa com todas as áreas. Este cargo se integra à organização como parte essencial da gestão de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (SSMA), garantindo conformidade legal e fortalecendo a cultura de segurança da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Realizar inspeções periódicas nos ambientes de trabalho, identificando condições inseguras, propondo melhorias e acompanhando a implementação das ações corretivas.

Elaborar, revisar e monitorar documentos obrigatórios, como PPRA/PGR, LTCAT, APRs e demais registros técnicos relacionados à segurança e saúde.

Conduzir treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos, garantindo compreensão, acessibilidade e engajamento de todas as pessoas colaboradoras.

Apoiar na investigação de incidentes e acidentes, analisando causas, registrando informações e sugerindo medidas preventivas para evitar recorrências.

Acompanhar e assegurar o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis, orientando equipes e monitorando procedimentos operacionais.

Solicitar exames periodicos, admissionais, mudança de função e demissionais.

Participar de reuniões de segurança, contribuindo com informações técnicas e fortalecendo a cultura de prevenção na organização.

Integrar ações com o setor de RH e liderança, auxiliando em processos de integração de novos colaboradores e projetos de ergonomia, saúde ocupacional e qualidade de vida.

Manter registros atualizados, organizar documentações e atuar com foco em melhoria contínua dos sistemas de gestão de segurança.

Qualificações

Formação completa como Técnico(a) em Segurança do Trabalho

Registro profissional ativo no MTE

Certificação e experiência comprovada em treinamentos de NR 33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR 35 (Trabalho em Altura) (Desejável)

Conhecimento das principais NRs e legislações vigentes relacionadas à segurança do trabalho

Competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para conduzir treinamentos de forma clara e acessível

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa, ética e orientação preventiva

Experiência prévia na área de segurança do trabalho (Desejável).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de risco e indicadores de segurança, além de E-social e SOC (Desejável).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Gente

Tecnologia é o que nos move e sustenta nosso crescimento acelerado.

Desde a base, cada moto sai da nossa garagem equipada com um dispositivo IoT, garantindo suporte 24/7 aos entregadores e gerando dados valiosos para a tomada de decisão.

Todo o nosso ecossistema tecnológico é desenvolvido internamente:

  • Sistemas próprios de gestão de frota, manutenção e atendimento;
  • Aplicativo e plataforma de delivery desenvolvidos do zero;
  • Arquitetura 100% em nuvem desde o início, com foco em boas práticas e tecnologias modernas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta performance, com entusiasmo por ver seus resultados impactando milhares de clientes diariamente;
  • Colaborar ativamente com o time, com boa comunicação, disposição para aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Demonstrar perfil analítico e proativo, com foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, adaptando-se rapidamente a mudanças;
  • Ter senso de dono, com responsabilidade de ponta a ponta pelas aplicações;
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial para acelerar entregas e elevar a qualidade dos produtos;
  • Aplicar conceitos sólidos de orientação a objetos, design patterns e arquitetura escalável;
  • Atuar com práticas DevOps, incluindo manutenção e monitoramento de ambientes de produção.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • + de 8 anos de experiência com C# e .NET Framework/Core;
  • Forte atuação no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Experiência com mensageria PUB/SUB (RabbitMQ, entre outros);
  • Uso de cache em aplicações (ex: Redis);
  • Criação e otimização de queries complexas;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como OpenAPI (Swagger), Postman, Git, GitFlow e Jira;
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (ex: Datadog, Dynatrace);
  • Conhecimento em microserviços (comunicação síncrona/assíncrona, Saga Pattern);
  • Forte compreensão de arquiteturas de alta escala e performance.

O que não combina com a gente

1. Resistência ao ritmo acelerado e à pressão

A Mottu tem uma cultura de alta performance, com foco em velocidade, entrega e resultado. O ambiente é intenso e muda rápido.

Quem não tem resiliência ou precisa de acompanhamento constante tende a ter dificuldade.

Aqui, não há espaço para zona de conforto ou microgestão.

2. ️ Falta de proatividade e aversão à "mão na graxa"

Valorizamos quem vai até a raiz do problema, entra na operação e resolve.

Esperar que outros tomem a frente, evitar tarefas operacionais ou depender de supervisão constante não combina com nossa cultura.

Quem não coloca a mão na massa dificilmente entende o que precisa ser melhorado — e não evolui aqui.

E quando falamos de "mão na graxa", é literal: vamos para a oficina, atuamos com o time e executamos funções operacionais.

Essa vivência prática traz insights que seriam impossíveis à distância.

3. Baixo espírito de dono e pouca autonomia

Esperamos atitude de dono: coragem para decidir, assumir riscos e gerar impacto real.

Quem espera ser "mandado" ou depende de validação constante tende a ficar para trás.

Aqui, protagonismo não é opcional — é parte do trabalho.

E diferente de muitas empresas, levamos isso a sério: quem entrega com consistência e atitude é reconhecido, recebe espaço e pode até se tornar sócio.

Stock options não são exceção — são consequência.

4. Falta de abertura para feedback e pouca maturidade emocional

Somos uma cultura de transparência direta. Feedbacks são frequentes, sinceros — e nem sempre suaves.

É preciso humildade e maturidade para encarar conversas difíceis, sem ego ou melindres.

Quem evita confronto construtivo ou não aceita críticas com boa intenção pode se sentir deslocado.

5. Apego rígido ao horário comercial

A Mottu ainda é uma startup em crescimento acelerado. Os desafios mudam rápido, e as demandas nem sempre respeitam o relógio.

Não há certo ou errado — o que importa é resolver o problema.

Se você busca rotina estável e separação rígida entre vida pessoal e trabalho, pode se frustrar aqui.

Entregar com qualidade é o foco — e isso nem sempre cabe dentro do horário comercial.

6. Falta de comprometimento e troca frequente de trabalho

Aqui, não buscamos apenas talento — buscamos gente que queira construir junto.

Se a cada desafio ou obstáculo a primeira reação é procurar a próxima oportunidade, dificilmente haverá tempo para gerar impacto real.

A Mottu é feita para quem tem visão de longo prazo, veste a camisa e está disposto a atravessar ciclos inteiros de crescimento, mostrar seu espaço e se tornar sócio.

Quem não se compromete, não colhe os frutos — e aqui, eles são grandes para quem fica e faz acontecer.

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Se você se identifica com esse ritmo, essa cultura e quer fazer parte de um time que realmente constrói tecnologia de impacto: vem com a gente.

title: Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing
description:
Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Visão Geral da Posição

O Consultor de Ativação de Marketing é responsável por configurar e executar campanhas de CRM e Loyalty no Salesforce Marketing Cloud, transformando estratégias de jornada em ações concretas por meio do uso avançado das funcionalidades da plataforma. Este cargo ativa jornadas de consumidor multi-etapas e multi-canais, aplicando regras de negócio, lógica de personalização e táticas de canal para entregar mensagens relevantes em grande escala.

Embora não seja responsável pelo desenvolvimento de backend ou automações técnicas, o profissional utiliza ferramentas nativas da plataforma (ex.: Journey Builder, Send Flows, Entry Criteria, Wait Steps, etc.) para executar campanhas de forma eficiente e precisa — sem necessidade de código. É necessário ter forte fluência nas capacidades de ativação self-service e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com leads de audiência, conteúdo e QA para garantir que todos os componentes estejam devidamente integrados.

Como especialista prático na configuração de jornadas e implantação de campanhas, este cargo permite que as marcas do setor entreguem comunicações consistentes, pontuais e de alto impacto via e-mail, push e outros canais próprios.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Direção de Marketing & Ativação

  • Traduzir estratégias de CRM e Loyalty em jornadas multi-etapas usando ferramentas self-service nativas da plataforma (ex.: funcionalidades drag & drop do SFMC).
  • Construir e lançar jornadas em E-mail, Push e SMS, incorporando lógica como wait steps, decision splits e regras de personalização baseadas nos objetivos da campanha.
  • Validar se todos os inputs necessários (ex.: audiências, templates, links, textos legais) estão completos e funcionais antes da ativação.
  • Monitorar jornadas ao vivo para detectar problemas de performance ou sinais operacionais (ex.: erros de audiência, falhas de lógica) e executar ajustes em tempo real quando necessário para garantir a integridade da execução.

Dados, Métricas & Otimização

  • Garantir a implementação correta da lógica de segmentação, critérios de entrada, tempos de espera e limites de frequência, alinhada à estratégia.
  • Marcar jornadas com IDs de campanha, metadados e parâmetros de rastreamento para suportar relatórios precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Analista de Performance & Insights para compartilhar observações da plataforma e validar os resultados das campanhas pós-lançamento.

Otimização de Processos de Campanha

  • Identificar lógicas repetitivas entre campanhas e propor estruturas modulares de jornada para aumentar a eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Manter documentação de melhores práticas de configuração de jornadas, checklists de QA de ativação e evolução dos padrões de execução.

Experiência e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de CRM, ativação de campanhas ou marketing de ciclo de vida, preferencialmente em organizações grandes e multi-mercado.
  • Experiência prática em lançamento e gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ESPs equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento funcional profundo de módulos da plataforma: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir estratégia em jornadas, utilizando wait steps, decision splits, filtros e lógica de conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Experiência em gerenciar calendários de campanhas complexos, com habilidade para lidar com várias ativações simultâneas em diferentes canais.

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC, que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, "Conforme + Dominante" significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C), mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D).

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

About the Role: This role involves advising on Murex best practices, contributing to client-site implementations, providing client support, and communicating development needs to the Murex product development team.

  • Documentation and Training: Provide internal and external documentation and training.

Qualifications:

  • Junior: Ideal candidate is someone with 2-3 years' experience in capital markets technology. The candidate should have a good understanding of accounting principles under IFRS or US GAAP. Knowledge of hedge accounting is a plus. Preferable experience includes supporting either trading, treasury or accounting at banks or other financial institutions or has experience with other fintech vendors. Strong academic background in accounting, engineering or a math-based discipline (math, operations research, statistics etc.). Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating system, SQL, and basic programming is a plus.
  • Senior: The ideal candidate has more than 5 years of experience in capital markets technology. Proven client-facing experience in a support or project implementation role, preferably in trading or risk management solutions in financial institutions. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a master's in financial engineering, Applied Finance/Statistics/Mathematics, or Computational Finance. Systematic problem solver with critical thinking abilities. Strong presenter and effective communicator. Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems, SQL, and basic programming.

Required Skills:

  • Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, COM, EQD, FXD, FXMM.

  • Good working knowledge of Murex Accounting knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of Back Office functions as well as processing.
  • Strong functional and technical understanding on the settlement instructions.
  • Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers.
  • Good understanding of OSP (open settlement protocol).

Preferred Skills:

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent.
  • Implementations and upgrades.
  • Test management.
  • Trade life cycle management.
  • Market Data management.
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing).
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)

Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.

Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools.

Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services.
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS, leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools.
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.

Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs, and microservices.
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Deep understanding of performance tuning, logging, and distributed tracing in cloud environments.

Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Knowledge of database performance tuning (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with API security, OAuth2/JWT, and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development: Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development: Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration: Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization: Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance: Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery: Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience
