title: Law Enforcement Specialist
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.

What You'll Do

The Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) works at the intersection of technology, public safety, and data privacy. Our mission is to support legitimate investigations by providing accurate, secure, and timely responses to requests from law enforcement and judicial authorities. We collaborate closely with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Operations teams to ensure compliance, transparency, and user data protection across all mobility platforms.

Key Responsabilities

  • Review, analyze, and respond to data requests from law enforcement, judicial, and regulatory authorities in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  • Ensure all disclosures are lawful, properly authorized, and aligned with privacy and data protection standards.
  • Support internal investigations related to security incidents, fraud, and misuse of the platform.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails of all requests and responses.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Privacy, Security, Operations, PR) in managing high-sensitivity cases.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and contribute to process automation and operational excellence.
  • Assist in developing and delivering training sessions related to law enforcement cooperation and incident management best practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, International Relations, Public Administration, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Previous experience working in law enforcement response, compliance, investigations, or similar roles in technology, telecommunications, finance, or mobility sectors.
  • Strong understanding of data protection laws (LGPD or GDPR) and law enforcement data request procedures.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ability to work under pressure, and strong decision-making skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using case management tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Jira).
  • Experience with process automation or data analysis for workflow improvement.
  • Knowledge of digital law, criminal law, or regulatory frameworks.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:
Let's talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, one of the world's largest tech and delivery ecosystems, with a bold mission: help people eat better and live better.

With that vision in mind, we're expanding globally and getting ready to launch our app in Brazil and we're looking for extraordinary people to join us on this journey of growth and innovation.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Job Responsibilities:As a key member of the local Human Resources team, you will be responsible for executing day-to-day HR operations with accuracy and compliance. This role ensures smooth employee lifecycle management and supports a positive employee experience.

1.Employee Onboarding & Offboarding:Manage end-to-end new hire onboarding, including document collection, system entry, and orientation coordination.Process employee resignations and terminations, conduct exit interviews, complete clearance procedures, and maintain accurate records in compliance with CLT regulations.

2.Employment Contract Management:Prepare, issue, renew, and archive employment contracts in accordance with Brazilian labor laws (CLT).Track probation periods and support performance evaluation processes.

3.Attendance & Timekeeping Administration:Monitor daily attendance using electronic time clock systems (e.g., Ponto Eletrônico). Review overtime, absences, leaves, and schedule adjustments. Collaborate with department heads to validate monthly attendance data.

4.Payroll Support & Social Contributions:Assist in monthly payroll processing, including calculation of salaries, bonuses, deductions, and overtime.Handle statutory contributions such as FGTS, INSS, and IRRF — ensuring accurate reporting and timely payments.Coordinate with internal finance or external payroll providers to ensure error-free disbursement.

5.New Employee Orientation:Deliver basic onboarding training sessions covering company policies, workplace rules, HR systems, and safety guidelines.Support new hires in integrating into the team and understanding their roles.

6.HR Data & Record Keeping:Maintain up-to-date employee master data, personnel files, and HR databases.Ensure confidentiality and compliance in all HR documentation and system entries.

Qualifications & Requirements:

1.Associate or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

2.Minimum 2 years of hands-on HR experience in a Brazilian company or multinational environment.

3.Solid understanding of Brazilian labor legislation (Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho – CLT).

4.Employee onboarding and offboarding.Employment contract administration.Attendance tracking and timekeeping systems (e.g., TOTVS, Senior, Oracle, etc.).Payroll support and social tax/filing (INSS, FGTS, IRRF)

5.Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable with strong execution skills.

6.Experience in conducting training or employee engagement activities.

7.Fluently English for business communication.

title: [TAG] Software Engineer Pleno - ServiceNow
description:
Quem é a Tag?

Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.

Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Regime: CLT

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Actions e GlideRecord.
  • Conhecimento de Flow Designer, IntegrationHub e REST APIs (RESTMessageV2).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter Widgets personalizados no Service Portal (HTML, AngularJS, Client/Server Script).

  • Vivência com CSM, ITSM, com visão de processo e integração.
  • Saber estruturar automação real, não só montar fluxos.
  • Experiência com Workspace / UI Builder (Polaris)
  • Integrações complexas (Slack, Twilio, Datadog, Azure, etc.)
  • Noções de versionamento e boas práticas de governança.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas e colaborar em projetos de melhoria e automação de processos
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com vontade de crescer junto com o time.

Nossos benefícios:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Horário flexível

Gympass

Auxílio Creche

PLR

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerTager

Aqui na TAG, valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar nesse movimento de transformação do mercado financeiro. title: Engenheiro(a) Civil Hidrólogo
description:
Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global. É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas.
  • Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo que inclui plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e alimentação, previdência privada, seguro de vida, wellhub, programa de incentivo de idioma e pós-graduação, além de opções de compra de ações da ENGIE.
  • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, nosso regime de trabalho é hibrido e flexível! Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão. Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

A sua missão

Como Engenheiro(a) Civil Hidrólogo do nosso departamento de Meio Ambiente, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias, desempenhando um papel crucial no desenvolvimento de estudos, programas e projetos socioeconômicos.

As suas principais responsabilidades

  • Elaborar e analisar estudos de modelagens matemáticas hidrodinâmicas de rios e/ou reservatórios incluindo montagem, calibração e simulação em modelos hidráulicos bidimensionais;
  • Elaborar e analisar estudo de modelagem matemática tridimensional para avaliação de estruturas hidráulicas;
  • Elaborar e analisar estudos hidrológicos e avaliações de capacidade hidráulica, disponibilidade hídrica, balanço hídrico do reservatório e análise da bacia de contribuição, análise dos projetos e documentação das estruturas;
  • Elaborar e analisar estudos de ruptura hipotética de barragens e pilhas e estudos de drenagem;
  • Elaborar e analisar estudos sedimentológicos, incluindo modelagem matemática em transporte de sedimentos.
  • Realizar viagens, visando subsidiar o desenvolvimento do projeto

Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil e/ou Hídrica.
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Experiência em modelagem hidrodinâmica bidimensional de rios e/ou reservatórios;
  • Capacidade de correlacionar os resultados hidrológicos/ hidráulicos obtidos das modelagens com os impactos relacionados a processos ambientais, suportado pela equipe técnica de meio ambiente;
  • Experiencias nos softwares AutoCAD Hec-Ras, RiverFlow, Flow3D, OpenFOAM.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel, as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE, com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

Candidate-se agora mesmo!

title: Tech Lead | Design System e HTML5
description:
Como Tech Lead com foco em Design System e HTML5 na Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na arquitetura e evolução do framework de front-end da nossa aplicação.

  • CI/CD, DevOps básico (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Actions).

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the 'BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client's data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account's objectives and the client's initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.

This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

title: Domain Architect Cybersecurity
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for a Domain Architect Cybersecurity, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / Remote, in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Cybersecurity has a strategic role in protecting critical operations in Brazil and Canada, designing, implementing and governing robust information security architectures. He will work in the construction of integrated solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, cyber risk management, incident response and protection of digital assets, industrial systems, networks and sensitive data in extremely complex and distributed environments.

This professional will support secure digital transformation, overseeing security frameworks, identity and access, encryption, advanced monitoring and compliance policies. He will work closely with technology, operations, governance, risk and physical security areas, working globally to ensure business continuity and cyber resilience.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, govern and evolve cybersecurity architectural models and standards, aligning global frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT) to the specific needs of operations.
  • Lead security architecture projects and initiatives for multi-cloud, on-premises, networking, application, industrial IoT/IIoT, data, and mobility environments.
  • Design solutions for threat prevention, detection, containment and remediation, integrating SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IAM and advanced encryption systems.
  • Work in the definition of identity and access policies and controls (IAM, SSO, MFA), network segmentation, endpoint protection, vulnerability management and governance.
  • Promote integration between physical security, IT, OT, and operations teams to create resilient and secure environments.
  • Develop and validate business continuity, cyber disaster recovery, and incident response strategies.
  • Evaluate and implement innovative security solutions (Zero Trust, Cloud Security Posture Management, Threat Intelligence, security automation and orchestration).
  • Ensure compliance with the data protection laws and regulations of the countries where it operates (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, safety plans, best practice guides, and training for internal teams.
  • Participate in technical communities, forums, audits and global compliance assessments.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Security, Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum experience of 8 years in cybersecurity architecture and governance, with relevant performance in complex corporate or industrial environments.
  • Deep knowledge in security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT, ITIL).
  • Expertise in network, host, application, identity, data and cloud security (MS Azure Security, AWS Security, GCP Security).
  • Experience with advanced tools: SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IAM, DLP, cryptography, risk analysis, pentest, advanced monitoring.
  • Experience in protecting OT/IT environments, security integration between industrial systems, industrial networks and corporate IT.
  • Practice with vulnerability management, container/Kubernetes security, security automation, DevSecOps.
  • Fluent English for technical and strategic communication, advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada collaborative work.
  • In-depth knowledge of privacy regulations, data protection and legislation of the countries where it operates.

Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, capable of influencing strategic safety decisions among global teams.
  • Analytical capacity and strategic vision to build resilient and business-aligned environments.
  • Clear and assertive communication with technical, executive and regulatory audiences.
  • Proactivity, adaptability and focus on delivering tangible and continuous protection to the business.
  • Multicultural, collaborative teamwork with high commitment.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Certified Security, PMP, TOGAF.
  • Experience in secure digital transformation projects in mining, energy or regulated industries.
  • Working knowledge of emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence in security, blockchain, security orchestration.
  • Participation in global governance and compliance programs (SOX, Sarbanes-Oxley, GDPR).
  • Track record securely across hybrid cloud, containers, microservices, and industrial IoT environments.
  • Participation in global security communities, lectures, technical publications.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Integrated cybersecurity architecture and governance for Brazil and Canada, covering multiple environments and technologies.
  • Execution of strategic projects to strengthen the protection, prevention, detection, response and recovery of cyber risks.
  • Dissemination of policies, planning and training, creating a culture of security and continuous compliance.
  • Technical and strategic support for audits, assessments and regulatory initiatives.
  • Pioneering the adoption of innovative technologies that ensure resilience and continuity of global and industrial operations.
  • Direct influence on risk mitigation and support of corporate reputation and safety.

Additional Comments:

This specialist will act as a key player in the global security strategy, ensuring the protection of critical assets in complex and distributed environments, with integrated Brazil-Canada action. We encourage professionals with an innovative, collaborative attitude and focused on concrete results.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
Senior ServiceNow Developer (Remote - Brazil or LATAM)

Company: Apricot Jam | Minneapolis-based | Global Delivery

Type: Full-Time | Remote | Contractor or FTE

Location: Brazil or broader LATAM (English-speaking)

About Us

We are Apricot Jam, a professional services company pioneering outsourcing, consulting, and tech, dedicated to putting people at the forefront of everything we do. Our mission is to foster creativity and ignite it, empowering individuals to unlock their full potential.

As a recognized ServiceNow partner based in the U.S., we specialize in delivering world-class ServiceNow implementations, custom apps, and managed services to clients ranging from startups to Fortune 100 enterprises. Our teams span across the globe, and we're proud of the cultural alignment, speed, and excellence they bring.

️ Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior ServiceNow Developer to join our high-performance global team. You'll build custom applications, automate workflows, and integrate ServiceNow across enterprise environments. This is a client-facing, hands-on development role requiring technical depth and clear communication.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain ServiceNow applications (scoped & global) across multiple modules.
  • Lead complex customizations using scripting (Glide, JavaScript) and automation tools, including custom workflows, UI policies, client scripts, and business rules.
  • Architect and implement REST/SOAP integrations, leveraging Integration Hub, MID Servers, and ERP connectivity.
  • Drive instance upgrades, performance optimization, and adherence to best practices.
  • Collaborate with US-based clients and cross-functional teams, gathering requirements and delivering enterprise-scale solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical solutioning and architecture decisions.
  • Stay up to date with ServiceNow releases, AI features, and industry trends, recommending adoption to clients.

Requirements

  • Certified System Administrator (CSA) – Required
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD) – Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering (minimum); a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus.
  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, with broad knowledge across multiple modules (ITSM, HRSD, CSM, ITOM, etc.)
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Glide, JavaScript, Flow Designer)
  • Experience with integrations, REST/SOAP, ERP systems, and AI-driven workflows
  • Proven client-facing experience, able to translate technical solutions for business stakeholders
  • Fluent in English (written & verbal)
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to operate in fast-paced, high-impact projects

Nice to Have

  • Experience with App Engine, Service Portal, Virtual Agent, Performance Analytics, ATF
  • Exposure to Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Additional ServiceNow certifications (CIS-ITSM, CIS-HR, CIS-ITOM, etc.)
  • Previous experience delivering solutions to US-based enterprise clients

Why Apricot Jam?

  • 100% Remote with Real-Time Collaboration (Overlapping U.S. hours)
  • People-First Culture – We profit share, we retain, we grow together
  • Global Clients – Work with publicly traded U.S. companies and high-growth tech
  • Elite Talent Pool – Top-tier colleagues, strong mentorship, and career growth
  • Long-Term Engagements – We invest in teams, not gigs

Interested?

Apply today and join a team that's shaping the future of enterprise automation.

Let's build something amazing together.

description:

Requisitos e qualificações

Sólidos conhecimentos em infraestrutura de redes com foco em ambientes industriais e minas de superfície.

Experiência com Windows Server 2016 ou superior.

Domínio em BC Commander / BC Enterprise e rádios Rajant ou tecnologias equivalentes.

Experiência em planejamento e manutenção de redes Ponto-a-Ponto (P2P) e redes Mesh (backhaul e EMS's).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento de rede, especialmente SolarWinds.

Familiaridade com TopCon Receiver Utility e ferramentas correlatas para gestão de hosts e ativos.

Experiência em monitoramento de servidores, EMS (Equipamentos Móveis de Solo) e ERB (Equipamentos de Rede Base).

Conhecimento de protocolos de segurança da informação e boas práticas de gestão de acesso remoto.

Experiência com switches Moxa e demais equipamentos industriais de rede.

Vivência em ambientes industriais e de mineração, com compreensão das rotinas e procedimentos operacionais de campo e mina.

Conhecimento em protocolos e padrões de conectividade, manutenção de ativos e análise de performance e cobertura de rede.

title: L2 - Security Engineer (EDR Solutions)
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)

Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.

Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.

Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.

Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator

At HCLTech, we don't just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

"A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de "staffing augmentation" dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do segmento de Indústria.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

– Desenvolvimento do Orçamento: Colaborar na preparação de orçamentos anuais, trimestrais e/ou mensais em conjunto com a equipe financeira e outros departamentos relevantes. Isso inclui a identificação de metas financeiras, a previsão de receitas e despesas e a alocação de recursos.

– Análise de Desempenho Financeiro: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho financeiro real em relação ao orçamento planejado, identificando variações e suas causas. Fornecer relatórios e recomendações para melhorar o desempenho. Conciliar contas de receita e custo e participar ativamente das análises de vendas e da cadeia de suprimentos.

– Revisão e atualização do orçamento: Realize revisões periódicas dos orçamentos conforme novas informações e cenários em mudança surgem. Faça ajustes e atualizações conforme necessário.

– Relatórios: Preparar relatórios financeiros e apresentações para a alta administração e partes interessadas internas, comunicando os resultados orçamentários e propondo ações corretivas quando necessário.

– Gestão de Despesas: Apoiar a gestão de despesas da empresa, garantindo que os custos permaneçam dentro dos limites orçamentários e identificando oportunidades de otimização de custos. Participar dos fluxos de trabalho de aprovação de despesas e da configuração de sistemas internos.

– Apoio a Projetos Especiais: Participe de projetos especiais relacionados a finanças, como análises de viabilidade, investimentos e planejamento estratégico.

– Conformidade e Auditoria: Garantir que todas as transações financeiras estejam em conformidade com os regulamentos e as políticas internas da empresa. Fornecer suporte para auditorias internas e externas.

O que você precisa ter:

– Sólida experiência em FP&A (experiência anterior em funções de análise financeira ou orçamentária);

– Comunicação e trabalho em equipe: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em um ambiente de equipe.

– Atenção aos detalhes: Fortes habilidades organizacionais e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

– Ferramentas de escritório: Proficiência no Microsoft Office, especialmente habilidades avançadas no Excel.

– Conhecimento de sistemas: experiência com Oracle e Power BI é um diferencial

Inglês avançado obrigatório, irá falar com chineses diariamente, precisa saber falar termos técnicos.

Atuação presencial em Pouso Alegre (avaliam profissionais que queiram se mudar para a região).

title: Domain Architect Operations Technology
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of São Paulo.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures, ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
  • Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.
  • Fluent English for global communication and advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada work.

Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
  • Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
  • Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
  • Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.
  • Ability to conduct global projects with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture and governance of OT solutions, supporting Brazil and Canada operations with security and innovation.
  • Leadership in OT digital transformation projects aiming at sustainability, automation and operational efficiency.
  • Support OT/IT integration, compliance, and governance of critical operations.
  • Dissemination of OT governance and global technical capacity building.
  • Increased resilience, safety and efficiency of industrial operations.

Additional Comments:

The OT Domain Architect is a key player in the technological and sustainable evolution of industrial operations, working in complex and global environments. Technical expertise, strategic vision, and collaborative capabilities are essential to strengthen technological leadership in the mining and energy sectors.

Nosso portfólio de eventos globais inclui Shoptalk, Spring Fair, Africa Oil Week, Mining Indaba e Bett.

Um pouco sobre a Bett:

Bett é um grande articulador do setor educacional, sendo a maior série de eventos globais de educação no mundo, composta por Bett UK, Bett Asia e Bett Brasil. Ao todo, nós recebemos mais de 70 mil visitantes globais e mais de 1.200 marcas expositoras.

Bett Conecta é o nosso programa de rodada de negócios que garante aos nossos participantes uma experiência com reuniões direcionadas e produtivas, significativas para transformar o setor educacional. Nós conectamos fornecedores de soluções com os líderes educacionais previamente ao evento, para que no mesmo eles consigam se encontrar e falar de negócios de forma prática e eficaz. Confira como foi a última edição.

Como Líder de Captação e Relacionamento, você será responsável por liderar a equipe responsável por convidar líderes educacionais para participarem gratuitamente da Bett Conecta, a rodada de negócios que acontece dentro da Bett Brasil. Garantir que a equipe esteja alinhada, engajada e preparada para atingir as metas de líderes educacionais confirmados, oferecendo suporte e acompanhando todo o processo até o dia do evento.

Além disso, você deverá estar presente nos dias do evento (05 a 08 de maio de 2026), colaborando para que a rodada de negócios seja um sucesso, apoiando a equipe e garantindo que os líderes educacionais compareçam às reuniões agendadas.

- Colaborar com a equipe de eventos para proporcionar uma experiência positiva aos participantes.

Requisitos

- Experiência na liderança de equipes e acompanhamento de metas.

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. - Organização, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de liderança.

- Proatividade e empatia no relacionamento com equipe e clientes.

- Experiência em eventos será considerada um diferencial.

Segunda a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h.

title: Solutions Consultant 2
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer's security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer's key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer's cybersecurity partner of choice.
Your Impact
Role
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.
  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.
  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences
  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.
  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space
  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering
  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.
  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
Additional Information
The Team
Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.
You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers' cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.
Our Commitment
We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
description:
Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno

***Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

***O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

***Nosso cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, que atua oferecendo serviços de logística e que se especializa na movimentação de contêineres e cargas em todo o Brasil.

***O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

- Atuar no ciclo de gestão de vulnerabilidades, incluindo análise de superfície de ataque, testes de invasão, avaliação de vulnerabilidades em código e imagens de containers, provendo direcionamento estratégico para mitigação dos riscos identificados;

- Cooperar com as áreas de Infraestrutura, Cloud, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e Sustentação na implementação de controles técnicos e procedimentais necessários para remediação de vulnerabilidades, promovendo integração entre equipes e sinergia dos processos;

- Acompanhar projetos de Pentest, conduzidos pelo Centro de Defesa Cibernética (CDC) ou por consultorias externas, desde o planejamento e execução até o acompanhamento do plano de correção, garantindo a efetividade das ações de remediação;

- Apoiar o time de Desenvolvimento de Software na integração de soluções de AppSec (Orca, Veracode e outras) ao pipeline de desenvolvimento, facilitando a identificação e resolução contínua de vulnerabilidades em ambientes;

- Monitorar e analisar relatórios periódicos de segurança cibernética e implementar planos de ação para melhoria contínua da postura de segurança, reportando indicadores ao Business Information Security Officer (BISO);

- Pesquisar, selecionar e coordenar provas de conceito (POC) de soluções de cibersegurança alinhadas com as necessidades estratégicas da empresa;

- Apoiar, quando necessário, auditorias internas e externas sobre maturidade em segurança da informação, fornecendo evidências, respostas técnicas qualificadas e conduzindo o plano de ação corretivo pós-auditoria.

***O que você precisa ter

- Formação superior preferencialmente na área de TI;

- Experiência prévia nas frentes de gestão de vulnerabilidades;

- Vivência com ferramentas e práticas de AppSec (Veracode, Snyk, Orca Security, CI/CD pipelines).;

- Conhecimento em frameworks e normas de segurança (OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK);

- Capacidade de analisar e comunicar resultados técnicos para áreas técnicas, gestão e executivos;

- Visão analítica, foco em resultados e senso de urgência para atuação diante de riscos e incidentes;

- Habilidade para comunicação efetiva e trabalho colaborativo com equipes técnicas e de negócio;

- Proatividade para propor melhorias e evolução dos processos e ferramentas;

- Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo, com forte autonomia e capacidade autodidata para atualização constante frente às mudanças e inovações tecnológicas.

***Você vai trabalhar

• Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido – Atuação presencial 2x por semana em no bairro do Cajuru, em Curitiba – PR.

title: User Acquisition Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Overview

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven professional to lead new user engagement initiatives through targeted segmentation and optimized incentive strategies. This role plays a key part in driving user growth and conversion across digital platforms, with a strong focus on performance analysis, experimentation, and cross-functional execution.

Job Responsabilities

Strategy and Planning

  • Develop annual and quarterly goals and operational plans for new user conversion.
  • Design differentiated conversion strategies based on user registration source, region, and timing.
  • Create incentive schemes such as first-order discounts, limited-time subsidies, and combo packages, and ensure their effective implementation.

Campaign Planning and Execution

  • Plan exclusive campaigns for new users, such as first-order discounts, first-week offers, and welcome bonuses.
  • Incorporate holiday promotions into marketing campaigns.
  • Coordinate with design, product, marketing, and merchant operations teams to ensure timely campaign launches and optimized user experience.

Data Analysis and Optimization

  • Monitor core metrics related to new user conversion (registration-to-first-order rate, first-order cost, early retention, etc.).
  • Conduct post-campaign reviews, analyze user behavior paths, and identify conversion bottlenecks.
  • Adjust strategies quickly based on data insights and continuously optimize performance.

User Insights and Segmentation

  • Analyze new users' characteristics based on source, preferences, and purchasing power.
  • Develop refined segmentation-based operational plans to improve conversion efficiency across different user segments.
  • Continuously iterate segmentation logic based on market competition and user feedback.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; preferred majors include engineering, business, or related fields.
  • Fluent in English, with proven ability to communicate effectively across international teams.
  • Experience in traffic operations, content distribution, growth product management, or similar roles within internet platforms.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, or local life services platforms is preferred; experience with local services platforms is a strong plus.
  • Overseas experience in internet product roles is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with in-platform resource management logic and a systematic understanding of user growth funnels.
  • Proficient in data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, BI platforms), with strong data sensitivity and analytical thinking.
  • Hands-on experience with traffic distribution strategies, content efficiency evaluation, and A/B testing design.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management skills; results-oriented with excellent execution capability.

title: Senior Manager, Shared Services Center
description:
About the company:

COFCO International is a global agribusiness company that purchases, stores, sells, processes, and distributes essential agricultural commodities: grains, oilseeds, sugar, cotton, and coffee.

Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, COFCO International employs approximately 11,000 professionals in 37 countries and has assets on every continent, with operations in more than 50 countries.

COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.

About the position:

Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.

Main responsibilities:

Develop and implement effective strategies for the SSC, aligned with the objectives of each business;

Identify and implement continuous improvements in SSC processes and systems, with the aim of increasing efficiency and reducing costs;

Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;

Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;

Ensure the control of service contracts, leases, and similar agreements, from the receipt of the supply process to the termination of the contract;

Manage COFCO's financial control involving Accounts Payable and Receivable operations, ensuring write-offs and controls and advances made to suppliers, following established policies;

Responsible for ensuring all COFCO Freight and Transit operations, from contracting services to accurate entries and payments;

Responsible for seeking efficiency in SSC operations through SLAs agreed with each business leader;

Ensure the accounting reconciliation of COFCO INTL companies in Brazil, aiming to comply with accounting standards and in line with global Controllership guidelines;

Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

Please send your resume in English.

COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified talent is welcome and considered for our positions, regardless of race or ethnicity, religious belief, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

Competências Técnicas:

Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.

Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).

Experiência com dados de IoT, especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.

Formação:

Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa nas áreas mencionadas.

Qualificação Avançada: Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou área afim. Certificações de nível Expert ou Specialty (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).

○DAMA CDMP (nível Associate ou Practitioner)
